title: Wylon · Results and configuration
unconfigured: No API key configured. Enter one below or set the server environment variable.
privacy: Generate with your own Wylon account. API keys stay out of workflows and generated files.
empty: No saved tasks yet. Run a Wylon node to begin.
failedLoad: Could not load Wylon metadata. Check the ComfyUI server log, then refresh.
copied: Task ID copied. Paste this video or historical asynchronous image task ID into the matching Wylon Get Task Result node to query the existing task.
copyFailed: Copy unavailable. Select and copy the task ID below.
resume: Retrieve existing results with a historical asynchronous image task ID or a video task ID in the matching Wylon Get Task Result node. Image generation is synchronous and returns no task ID; video generation submits and waits. Only video has a seed and a local next-run seed policy. Queueing a Generate node sends a new generation request and may incur charges.
rememberKey: Remember on this machine (private ComfyUI user configuration)
keyStorageHelp: Without “Remember”, the key lasts only for this ComfyUI server run. Priority: session, saved local key, then environment. Keys never enter node inputs, workflows or media metadata.
keySaved: API key applied. Verifying the connection.
keySaveFailed: Configuration failed. Check the key, same-origin connection and server file permissions.
keyCleared: Selected key cleared. Any remaining configured status comes from another source.
environmentHelp: Alternatively set WYLON_API_KEY in the terminal that starts ComfyUI. A .env file is not loaded automatically. Use a Wylon key, not an OpenAI or Comfy account key.
noResults: No local results yet. Run a Wylon image or video node, or use a Get Task Result node with a video task ID or historical asynchronous image task ID.
connectionFailed: Connection could not be verified. Check your key and Wylon availability; configured does not mean verified.
moreAvailable: Showing the first page. More records are available through the paginated API.
workflowRejected: Wylon workflow could not be loaded
